analysis:
Reviewed MultiModelBatchSchedulerEngine.swift head 519-1443. The only changed behavior is the loop-exit-thinking continuation (head 1024-1035 and 1108-1169). The media paths at 571-910 and the cluster GLM, Qwen and MiMo helpers are unchanged context.

New behavior: GenerationLoopExitThinkingPolicy is resolved only for single-Mac text rows without logprobs; it is disabled when servesDistributedPair is not false (line 1029). When the loop guard ends a thought, LoopExitThinkingContinuation.splice submits a second engine row with the id requestId+"-exit" on the same bridge.

Prefix-cache isolation (T-041/SEC-035) is preserved. The continuation reuses the coordinator-authored requestCacheScope, cacheEnabled and donationDemand (lines 1118-1120, 1149-1150), so cacheSalt scoping is unchanged. No tenant-controlled scope is introduced.

Cancellation (T-010): the spliced cancel covers both rows (1161, 1168), and the stream releaseBox/deadline wrapper still wraps the combined events (1171-1176).

Output validation is unchanged. answerFormat, toolHandler and withholdReasoning are still applied downstream to the spliced stream.

Unverified contracts for integration (outside the supplied evidence):
(1) Billing/usage. The continuation submit omits usageSignal, serviceReservationID/serviceReservation and promptWork (1142-1157). It also skips the 5-second row-release wait failure path. Integration should confirm that LoopExitThinkingContinuation accounts for the continuation row's prompt and completion tokens in reported usage. It should also confirm the continuation is admitted against the service and KV budget rather than bypassing them (A-018 availability).
(2) Output budget. The budget passed to submit must be the remaining allowance, not a fresh full outputBudget. Otherwise a consumer that induces looping thoughts could obtain more output than max_tokens.
(3) Constraint scope. tokenConstraint is nil for the continuation (1157). GenerationLoopExitThinkingPolicy/GenerationLoopGuardPolicy should only enable exitThinking when no JSON or tool token constraint applies, or else rely on post-validation.

The splice implementation and policy sources were not supplied, so no finding is asserted.
